description: Inventory the mobile-forensic structures inside an iOS full file-system tar without extracting it: core databases, their WAL/SHM companions, Biome/SEGB, unified logs, keychain, photos metadata and app-container mappings.
covers: The paths, sizes and archive timestamps of mobile-forensic structures in one iOS full file-system tar, plus SQLite companion presence. Member names are kept as the archive spelled them (path_b64 is the exact bytes), every occurrence of a duplicated name is its own row with its position, and a database that occurs twice keeps both sizes. It extracts nothing, parses no artifact content, decrypts no protected data and does not claim that a listed path contains responsive records.
